declarations.bibleVerseText: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

declarations.text: The Spirit's fruit grows in you naturally. But only if you stay connected. Dead branches don't fruit.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, forbearance, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.

declarations.text: You died with Christ. Your old self is gone. Now Christ lives in you. Let Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me.

declarations.text: Sow to the flesh and reap destruction. Sow to the Spirit and reap eternal life. You choose every day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever sows to please their flesh will reap destruction; whoever sows to please the Spirit will reap eternal life.

declarations.text: God chose you on purpose. Before you did anything right. Before you did anything wrong. On purpose.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we know, brothers and sisters loved by God, that he has chosen you.

declarations.text: Rejoice always. Pray without stopping. Give thanks in everything. That is God's will for your life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: God sanctifies your whole self. Spirit. Soul. Body. Nothing is left out. He goes all the way.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May God himself, the God of peace, sanctify you through and through.

declarations.text: You are not in the dark. You are a child of light. Light people don't get ambushed by darkness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you, brothers and sisters, are not in darkness so that this day should surprise you like a thief. You are all children of the light and children of the day. We do not belong to the night or to the darkness.

declarations.text: Jesus is coming back. That is not a maybe. It is a certainty. Live every day with that in mind.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the Lord himself will come down from heaven, with a loud command, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet call of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.

declarations.text: God is faithful. He strengthens you. He guards you from the enemy. You don't stand alone.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.

declarations.text: Stand firm. Hold fast. Don't let every new wind move you. Know what you believe and stay there.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold fast to the teachings we passed on to you, whether by word of mouth or by letter.

declarations.text: God encourages your heart. He strengthens you in every good word and work. You are not doing this alone.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and by his grace gave us eternal encouragement and good hope, encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good deed and word.

declarations.text: Let God direct your heart into His love. Into Christ's perseverance. That is where the strength comes from.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the Lord direct your hearts into God's love and Christ's perseverance.

declarations.text: Grace and peace are yours. Not from the world. From God Himself. Receive them both today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Grace and peace to you from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: Your own understanding has limits. God's does not. Trust Him with your whole heart and stop leaning on what you think you know.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.

declarations.text: You can plan your way or submit your way. Only one leads somewhere. Give God control and He will make your path straight.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.

declarations.text: Silver can be lost. Gold can be stolen. Wisdom builds wealth no one can take from you. Seek it above everything else.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are those who find wisdom, those who gain understanding, for she is more profitable than silver and yields better returns than gold.

declarations.text: You can make your plans. God will determine your steps. Stop fighting His direction and let Him establish your path.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.

declarations.text: What you let into your heart will come out in your life. Guard it above all else. Everything flows from it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.

declarations.text: Your path does not stay dim. Walk right and it gets brighter. Every day builds on the last. Keep going.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The path of the righteous is like the morning sun, shining ever brighter till the full light of day.

declarations.text: Your plans without God are just wishes. Commit your work to Him and He will make them stand.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.

declarations.text: Your words either turn away anger or stir it up. A soft answer is not weakness. It is wisdom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

declarations.text: Honor God and your days are added to. Ignore Him and they are cut short. That is not a threat. It is a law.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The fear of the Lord adds length to life, but the years of the wicked are cut short.

declarations.text: Nothing you could ever want compares to wisdom. Not money. Not status. Not comfort. Seek it and you will have more than you imagined.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.

declarations.text: Wise lips spread knowledge. Foolish hearts spread nothing. What comes out of your mouth reveals what is in your heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The lips of the wise spread knowledge, but the hearts of fools are not upright.

declarations.text: Iron sharpens iron. Who you surround yourself with will either sharpen you or soften you. Choose your circle on purpose.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another.

declarations.text: You can make 100 plans. Only God's purpose will stand. Stop fighting His will. Align with it and watch things move.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Many are the plans in a person's heart, but it is the Lord's purpose that prevails.

declarations.text: Your reputation outlasts your bank account. A good name is worth more than silver or gold. Build it on purpose.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A good name is more desirable than great riches; to be esteemed is better than silver or gold.

declarations.text: Lazy hands make for poverty. Diligent hands bring wealth. You cannot pray your way out of what you must work your way through.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Lazy hands make for poverty, but diligent hands bring wealth.

declarations.text: The blessing of God brings wealth without painful toil. Stop working harder in your own strength. Start walking in His blessing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The blessing of the Lord brings wealth, without painful toil for it.

declarations.text: Your words carry the power of life and death. You will eat the fruit of what you say. Speak life every single day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.

declarations.text: Your character is either a crown or decay to those closest to you. Choose noble character. Build your home up.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A wife of noble character is her husband's crown, but a disgraceful wife is like decay in his bones.

declarations.text: Strength and dignity are your clothing. When you wear them, you can laugh at what comes next. Fear has no power over a prepared person.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She is clothed with strength and dignity; she can laugh at the days to come.

declarations.text: The people closest to you should be your greatest testimony. Live so well that your family calls you blessed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Her children arise and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praises her.

declarations.text: Wisdom is more profitable than silver. Understanding yields better returns than gold. Stop chasing money. Chase wisdom and it will bring you both.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are those who find wisdom, those who gain understanding, for she is more profitable than silver.

declarations.text: Integrity does not just feel good. It protects you. Righteousness guards your path. Wickedness destroys from the inside out.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Righteousness guards the person of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

declarations.text: Wisdom builds the house. Understanding makes it stand. Knowledge fills it with treasure. You do not build a great life by accident.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By wisdom a house is built, and through understanding it is established; through knowledge its rooms are filled with rare and beautiful treasures.

declarations.text: What you plant in your children today will grow for decades. Start them right. It will last longer than you will.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.

declarations.text: Pride does not build you up. It brings you down. A haughty spirit comes before a fall. Stay humble and stay standing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall. Better to be lowly in spirit along with the oppressed than to share plunder with the proud.
